summary: SoloOS v1.0.0 Beta — complete iOS + Android MVP. 100% on-device business OS for solopreneurs: clients, invoices, time tracking, proposals, contracts, financial dashboard, AI Business Advisor, recurring invoices, and data export. Zero backend, zero cloud.
included: Client management — profiles, billing history, communication notes, pipeline view (leads → active → completed)
Invoice creation — multi-line items, tax, PDF generation and share
Invoice from unbilled time entries — one-tap billing for logged hours
Email invoice + AI-drafted follow-up for overdue invoices (mailto: — user's own email)
Time tracking — live timer and manual log, billable vs non-billable, tag by client
Proposals — 4 templates (Web, Mobile, Consulting, Brand) + custom creation
Financial dashboard — income vs expenses, cash flow 8-week projection, quarterly tax estimate
AI Business Advisor — on-device LLM (llama.cpp + Metal) with RAG over your own business data; rule-based fallback when no model loaded
Streaming AI responses — token-by-token display, thinking indicator
Contracts — templates and creation with status tracking
Settings — AI engine status, starting balance for cash flow, GGUF model install instructions
Data export — full JSON backup of all data via share sheet
SOTheme — dark navy + gold accent design system (Plus Jakarta Sans, 100% dark mode)
iOS (SwiftUI, min iOS 17, SwiftData) + Android (Jetpack Compose, minSdk 26, Room DB v4)
